verdict.rationale: Deepgram is a SaaS API platform rather than a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs say the `dg` CLI includes a built-in MCP server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, and a probe confirms an official MCP server page under agentic tools. Missing for 10: detail on which tools the MCP server exposes (especially whether it covers Voice Agent configuration and management), setup and client-connection documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
